description: Every PSX data-portal surface in one Go binary, plus the local price history the exchange itself throws away.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

tools.name: announcements_list
tools.description: Search announcements across company, PSX, SECP, NCCPL and CDC streams. Optional: stream (default: C), symbol, query (plus 5 more).

params.name: stream
params.description: Stream: C companies, E PSX notices, B SECP notices, D NCCPL notices, A CDC notices

params.name: symbol
params.description: Filter to one instrument code, e.g. OGDC

params.name: page
params.description: Portal page context; leave at the default

tools.name: board_show
tools.description: Trading board for one market and board combination. Required: market, board.

params.name: market
params.description: Market code: REG regular, ODL odd lot, DFC deliverable futures, SQR square up, CSF cash settled futures

params.name: board
params.description: Board: main, gem (growth), or bnb (bonds and notes)

tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: AGM and EOGM events in a date window. Required: from, to. Returns array of CalendarEvent.

tools.name: circuit-breakers_list
tools.description: Instruments halted by a price circuit breaker, with the limit band and halt state that triggered the suspension.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Company profile and quote page for an instrument. Required: symbol.

tools.name: company_reports
tools.description: Financial report index for an instrument. Required: symbol.

tools.name: debt_list
tools.description: TFCs, Sukuks and other debt instruments with coupon, maturity and yields.

tools.name: eligible-scrips_list
tools.description: Securities eligible for margin trading and margin financing.

tools.name: history_get
tools.description: Full OHLCV history for a symbol. PSX ignores date parameters and always returns the complete series. Required: symbol.

tools.name: indices_list
tools.description: All PSX indices with current level and change.

tools.name: listings_table
tools.description: Listed companies filtered by board and listing status. Required: board, status.

tools.name: market_debt_performers
tools.description: Most active debt instruments by turnover, covering TFCs, Sukuks and government paper on the bonds board.

tools.name: market_performers
tools.description: Top active, gainer and loser tables for the equity market.

tools.name: market_watch
tools.description: Whole-market snapshot table: LDCP, open, high, low, current, change, volume.

tools.name: payouts_company
tools.description: Full payout history for one instrument. Required: symbol.

tools.name: payouts_list
tools.description: Payout history across all instruments. Optional: symbol, limit (default: 25), offset (default: 0).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Filter to one instrument code, e.g. OGDC

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of payout rows to return

tools.name: screener_list
tools.description: Market cap, price, PE (TTM), dividend yield, free float, 30-day average volume and 1-year change.

tools.name: sectors_summary
tools.description: Per-sector aggregates: advances, declines, turnover and market cap.

tools.name: sectors_top
tools.description: Top sectors ranked by traded volume. Returns array of SectorVolume.

tools.name: symbols_list
tools.description: List every listed instrument with sector, ETF and debt flags. Returns array of Symbol.

tools.name: timeseries_eod
tools.description: End-of-day series as [epoch, close, volume, open] tuples. Required: symbol. Returns array.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Instrument or index code, e.g. OGDC or KSE100

tools.name: timeseries_intraday
tools.description: Intraday tick series as [epoch, price, volume] tuples (last active session). Required: symbol. Returns array.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Instrument or index code, e.g. OGDC or KSE100

novel_features.name: Corporate-action digest
novel_features.description: See every announcement, payout, AGM date and circuit-breaker event for the symbols you track, in one place.

novel_features.name: Snapshot delta
novel_features.description: Show what changed in price, volume and valuation metrics between two synced snapshots.

novel_features.name: Local watchlist
novel_features.description: Keep a saved symbol set and price it on demand, with change measured from the day you added each name.

novel_features.name: Baseline-relative anomaly scan
novel_features.description: Find names trading abnormally against their own trailing history, not just the day's biggest movers.

novel_features.name: Sector rotation
novel_features.description: Rank sectors by movement over a window and name the constituents that drove each move.

novel_features.name: Valuation drift
novel_features.description: Trace one symbol's PE, dividend yield, market cap or free float across time.

novel_features.name: Futures basis
novel_features.description: Compare futures-board prices against the regular spot board to see premium or discount per symbol.

novel_features.name: Regulatory document search
novel_features.description: Search PSX regulatory documents, listing guides and notices by keyword, with last-updated dates.
